literal_meaning: জ্বলন্ত এবং পুঁজে ওঠা ক্ষতের শব্দানুকরণ
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার মনে এই ঘটনা দগদগে ঘা হয়ে রয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: This incident has become a festering sore in his mind.
The old wound has become raw and inflamed.
note: This term is onomatopoeic, mimicking the sensation of burning pain, commonly used in Bengali literature to describe both physical and metaphorical wounds.
